annotations.title: Extract dates and deadlines from text

description: Extract dates and deadlines from text — Pulls every date, deadline, date range, time and recurring schedule out of free text (emails, contracts, chats, tickets) and resolves relative wording like next Friday or end of Q3 against a reference date into ISO dates, with weekday, days from the reference date, the event each date belongs to, and the next upcoming one. Dates are validated offline. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

ref.description: optional reference date YYYY-MM-DD (default today UTC)

text.description: text containing dates, e.g. Please send the draft by next Friday; the review call is every Monday at 10am

name: ai_dates
